topology_note: SW1 (Gi0/1 trunk) connected to SW2 (Gi0/1 trunk). VLANs 1, 10, 20 are in use. SW1 is configured with native VLAN 1; SW2 was recently reconfigured.
expected_fault: Native VLAN mismatch on the trunk link between SW1 (native VLAN 1) and SW2 (native VLAN 99) causes untagged frames to be mishandled and management traffic to be dropped.
source_evidence:
